hot.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day

hot.typical_scene: Tom Holland in a sleek new suit mid-swing over a neon-lit city

hot.name: Tom Holland
hot.why_hot_now: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is still box-office king, and a viral video of him performing a rain-soaked 'Singin' in the Rain'/'Umbrella' mashup at the London premiere broke the internet.
hot.typical_scene: drenched in rain, jazz-hands grin, tuxedo, London premiere stage

hot.name: Zendaya
hot.why_hot_now: Spider-Man: Brand New Day press tour plus news that she and Tom Holland secretly got married, which she confirmed by trolling a fan who proposed to her on a red carpet.

hot.name: Ariana Grande
